components.name: RefreshButton
components.description: Outline refresh action whose icon spins while `refreshing`.

props.name: loading
props.description: Blocks clicks while an action runs. `true` shows a spinner before the label (in place of `leading`); `"spin-icon"` spins the `leading` icon.

props.name: href
props.description: Renders an `<a>` with the same look instead of a `<button>`.

props.name: leading
props.description: Content before the label, usually an icon.

props.name: trailing
props.description: Content after the label (and after `count`), usually an icon.

props.name: iconOnly
props.description: Square button that holds only an icon (the children). Give it an `aria-label` for its accessible name.

props.name: block
props.description: Stretches to the full width of its container.

props.name: count
props.description: Number shown inline after the label as a notification badge.

props.name: icon
props.description: A named arrow, or any icon node.

props.name: speed
props.description: How fast the icon turns while `refreshing`.

examples.title: speeds
examples.code: {SPEEDS.map((speed) => ( {speed[0].toUpperCase() + speed.slice(1)} ))}
